subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should forced cookie re-import extend `codexbar cache clear`, become a separate `cookie refresh` command, or remain an in-app provider recovery action?
rationale: The repository already has provider-scoped cookie clearing, the linked issue explicitly leaves command shape and scope open, and this branch adds two new product surfaces without maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Extend cache clear
options.body: Add an explicit re-import mode to the existing cache command so cookie lifecycle operations remain under one CLI surface.

options.title: Keep cookie refresh
options.body: Approve a separate command after defining supported providers, browser ordering, exit codes, JSON output, and platform limitations.

options.title: Settings recovery only
options.body: Keep the operation inside the signed app where browser-cookie access can be demonstrated and remove the CLI import promise.

recommendation.title: Extend cache clear
recommendation.body: Add an explicit re-import mode to the existing cache command so cookie lifecycle operations remain under one CLI surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available owner based on current CLI/cookie integration history and repository-level product decisions.
